subject: StrikeZone executive offsite — agenda cadence, presenter owners & prework
messages:
From: Samantha Jansen <samantha.jansen@strikezone.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Rhee <trhee@strikezone.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StrikeZone exec offsite — initial ask

Thanks for taking this on, Sean. Our leadership asked that the offsite focus tightly on (1) productionizing our recommendation model latency improvements, (2) a 60‑minute roadmap alignment on ML investments, and (3) a short tabletop on incident response / fallbacks.

High level asks from our side:
- A 2.5 day flow (Day0 orientation, Day1 deep tech, Day2 exec strategy)
- Presenter owners for each slot (we can invite external vendors where helpful)
- A 1–2 page pre‑read for each major block that leaders can scan in advance (we have 20 minutes max per person to review)

Can you send a draft agenda + presenter assignments by Monday the 15th? Also confirm whether you can host a 30‑minute prep call with presenters next week.

Attachments: none in this thread but I will share our internal org chart separately.

Samantha
Samantha Jansen
VP, Product & Data | StrikeZone
Samantha.Jansen@strikezone.com
Mobile: (415) 555‑0184

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Jansen <samantha.jansen@strikezone.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StrikeZone exec offsite — initial ask

Samantha — thanks, clear brief. Drafting a compact agenda and pre‑read plan and looping in Marissa (ops) + Mateo (content) to own logistics and decks.

Proposal (high level):
- Day0 (half day afternoon): arrival + orientation, leadership context setting (30m), lightning product demos (60m), evening welcome dinner (optional)
- Day1 (full day):
  - Morning: deep tech sessions (2 x 75m blocks: "latency & KV cache patterns"; "quant & model footprinting") — presenters: Mateo (tech lead) + RedTeam engineer (TBD)
  - Lunch + 30m customer Q&A
  - Afternoon: hands‑on runbooks / workshop (2 x 60m) — owners: StrikeZone SRE + Redwood reliability lead
- Day2 (half day morning):
  - Exec roadmap alignment (60m) — ownership: Samantha + Redwood Head of Product
  - Tabletop incident simulation (45m) — ownership: Mateo + StrikeZone ops
  - Close / next steps (15m)

Pre‑read plan: one 1‑pager per major block (we will circulate as single bundle):
- Day0: orientation & goals (owner: Sean)
- Day1‑AM: technical primers (owner: Mateo)
- Day1‑PM: workshop context + data access checklist (owner: Marissa)
- Day2: exec topics + rubric for decisions (owner: Sean)

Requests / open items:
- Can we get attendee list + titles by Friday so we can finalize presenter cadence?
- Any constraints on external presenters or vendors? (SaaS vendor approvals, NDAs)
- Do you want decks to be camera‑ready or rough + talk tracks?

I'll attach a first agenda and a presenter roster for your review (v0.3). We can iterate. Propose a 30‑minute presenter prep on Tue 16th at 10am PT — does that work for your team?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Customer Lead | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
O: 650‑555‑1212

Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StrikeZone executive offsite — agenda cadence, presenter owners & prework

Adding a few operational tweaks after sync with venue + travel ops:
- Day0: shift start to 1:00pm PT (venue room not ready until 12:30) — we keep lightning demos but compress to 45m so arrivals aren't rushed.
- AV ask: we need 2 clickers, wired laptop station, and one local AV tech on call (I will book)
- Meals: confirm dietary for evening dinner — Samantha, can ops send preferences?

Presenter roster notes (attached spreadsheet):
- Mateo will lead the tech primer but requests a 30m block to demo cache profiling results — move the demo from "lightning" into Day1‑AM second block.
- Suggest we make the incident tabletop a 60m slot to include debriefs (45m + 15m debrief) — roleplay plan attached.

Pre‑reads: prepping a single ZIP with 4 PDF one‑pagers and a short link file for artifacts. I attached v0.3 agenda + presenter roster (presenter_roster_v1.xlsx).

I can host the presenter prep call Tue 16th 10am PT. Agenda for prep call (30m):
- Quick intros (5m)
- 3 min owner 1‑pager summary each (10m)
- Logistics + AV run (5m)
- Q&A and deliverable deadlines (10m)

I'll circulate calendar invites once Samantha confirms attendees.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Program Manager, Customer Events | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: presenter_roster_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), strikezone_exec_agenda_v0.3.pdf (PDF)

This looks great — thanks all for the quick turnaround. A few confirmations: 
- 1:00pm Day0 start works for us; we will aim to arrive by 12:30 for quick set up.
- We confirm Mateo for the tech primer and the extra 30m demo slot. Please ensure the demo laptop has local copies of profiling artifacts (Mateo, I can arrange secure transfer).
- We accept the 60m tabletop + 15m debrief.
- External presenters: we want one vendor (FeatureOps) in the Day1‑PM workshop; they are approved as long as they sign our RSA (I will share).
- Pre‑reads: one bundle is perfect — leaders asked that each page include a 2‑line TL;DR at the top.

Jess (cc'd) from our travel ops will send dietary restrictions and an attendee list by EOD Thursday.

Can you please share the first bundle (v0.3) as a single link? I'll route through my admin to ensure distribution to execs.

Thanks — look forward to the prep call on Tue 16th at 10am PT.

Best,
Samantha
VP, Product & Data | StrikeZone
